recommendation.scope: Introduce explicit anchor/tier-aware readiness only for callers that already bind historical/checkpointed reads. Preserve current proposed equality as default for generic callers. No arbitrary common minimum/fallback anchor.
invariant: Identity/proof policy, ordered tips, coherent world metadata, freshness and finality policy unchanged.

Selected canonical tier anchor must be present in retained history and no newer than world DB head. Reject world head above observed proposed tip as inconsistent; bounded existing reacquisition may collect a new whole snapshot.

Verify world latest hash against canonical metadata at its own height, not against proposed hash at a different height. Verify selected anchor and world head before/after as required; never treat synced boolean or height-only comparison as sufficient.
Caller still verifies exact requested old anchor and cryptographic history/read proof; readiness snapshot is not authorization for arbitrary unanchored future queries.

Pass explicit tier consistently through native compact and compact gateway readiness. Reader can pass its already-bound tier; generic private RPC/createTrustedPrivateNode policy must be deliberately reviewed instead of silently inheriting relaxed global semantics.
recommendation.smallestFocusedCheck: Extend existing trusted-node fixture with proposed1471/worldcheckpoint1470: explicit checkpointed readiness succeeds only with canonical matching hashes; default/proposed mode remains fail-closed. Reuse compact/gateway fixtures to prove before/after binding and unchanged HTTP errors.

failureCases: World below selected checkpoint; pruned selected checkpoint; world above proposed; same-height fork; world own-height hash mismatch; selected anchor or world head reorg at final fence; malformed/false-sync/stale/wrong identity/proof policy; finality mismatch; request newer than configured tier; hung grouped peer still drained; no unrequested fallback to older anchor.
